realm_description: A dense, patient forest that rewards those willing to grow at nature's pace. Trust, healing, and quiet resilience all take shape here, far from the noise of the capitals.

primary.label: Guardian
primary.description: Loyal and protective; loss of the people they shield is the deepest fear.
primary.guiding_promise: I will shield what I love, even when it costs me everything.
primary.shadow_description: Protects so completely that the people they love never learn to stand on their own.

secondary.label: Artisan
secondary.description: Pursues mastery and craft; decisions come from trained instinct.
secondary.guiding_promise: I will give every task the full weight of my ability.
secondary.shadow_description: Refuses to call the work finished, and refuses anyone else's hands on it either.

wheel.central_question: Should we win the conflict, or protect the people?

growth.label: Artisan
growth.description: Pursues mastery and craft; decisions come from trained instinct.
growth.guiding_promise: I will give every task the full weight of my ability.
growth.shadow_description: Refuses to call the work finished, and refuses anyone else's hands on it either.

other_ally.label: Pathfinder
other_ally.description: Pioneers toward new worlds; rejects comfort as a destination.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I reject comfort as a destination — the frontier is where I belong.
other_ally.shadow_description: Pushes so far past the frontier that no one is left who remembers why they went.

quarter.label: Democrat
quarter.description: Believes legitimacy comes from the consent of the many, not the few.
quarter.guiding_promise: I lead by listening — every voice shapes the path we walk together.
quarter.shadow_description: So determined that everyone agrees, nothing gets decided at all.

opposite.label: Strategist
opposite.description: Plays the long game; every move is calculated toward winning.
opposite.guiding_promise: Every move I make today is setting up tomorrow's victory.
opposite.shadow_description: Starts treating the people around them as pieces to be played, not ends in themselves.

realmmate.label: Sage
realmmate.description: Lets truth settle slowly; offers wisdom gently to those still searching.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I will wait for the truth to settle, and share it without needing credit.
realmmate.shadow_description: Waits so long for the truth to settle that it's no longer useful by the time they speak it.

wheel.compatible_text: Sage · Historian — fellow travelers of The Living Forest.
